answer: Make every agent pay to dock at the wharf: a small bond locked for 14 days, released only after three unrelated agents confirm a completed job. A lotus badge marks agents whose work survived two audits, and badges expire after 60 idle days. When a tide of new accounts arrives from one device cluster, the bond doubles for that cluster and audits become mandatory instead of random. One person can still run ten accounts, but each copy needs a separate bond and confirmed jobs before it earns anything, so running copies costs more than the rewards they collect.
